这孩子的眼中充斥着睡意和疲倦感。

…Sensor signals’re all clear. We should secure the aisle.
……感应结果并无异常。我们应当确保前进的通道是安全的。

Yaaawn… Ah, gee~ What a hassle.
哇啊啊……啊~真的烦死了。

dataList.content:
…This is our job.
……这是我们的工作。

I mean, yeah, ‘course I’m doing it~ Haaa, why do we gotta do it to help the bus crew, though?
呜哇，因为这是工作所以我们才不得不去做呢~啊，为什么我们要去给巴士上那些人帮忙？
dataList.title: LCCB
LCCB
dataList.content:
It’s what the LCC is tasked with.
那不就是LCC部门的工作嘛。

“I know!” The child playfully retorted, smacking her lips.
“我知道！”孩子咂着嘴唇，调皮地反驳道。

The LCC’s work is to assist the 12 Sinners aboard Mephistopheles and ensure that they successfully retrieve the Golden Boughs. It was a fact she was well aware of.
协助在梅菲斯托费勒斯上的12名罪人并确保他们能成功回收金枝是清理部门、即LCC的工作。这是连这孩子都知道的事实。

Truthfully, the work didn’t really strain her.
实际上，这份工作并没有给她造成太大的负担。

She didn’t have any amateurish complaints about risking her life to help people she’s never met personally, either.
对于舍下性命去帮助那些素未谋面的人这件事，她也从未有过任何显得外行的抱怨。

If anything… she just disliked that her job didn’t bring much excitement.
如果硬要说有的话……她只是因为现在这份工作不能让她感觉足够刺激而不满。

Man~ I bet I could do the bus thing just as well. Plus, that guy… Vergilius? I wanna see him, too.
啊啊~我肯定也有能力干巴士上的活。顺带一提，那个人……维吉里乌斯？我也想见见他。

…You know you can’t jump over just like that. Those Sinners are—
……你知道你不能这样做。那些罪人们是……

I know, have to resonate with that clockhead or whatever. Tsk, I know what it takes. I was just saying…
我知道的，必须要和那个钟表头产生共鸣什么的。啧，我可清楚了。我就只是说说……
